name: Variational Tetrahedral Mesh Generation from Discrete Volume Data
definition: A novel tetrahedral mesh generation algorithm that takes volumic data (voxels) as input, performs clustering of original voxels within a variational framework, replaces each cluster with a vertex, and triangulates the vertices to obtain a tetrahedral mesh while considering accuracy and element quality.
summary: Variational Tetrahedral Mesh Generation creates high-quality tetrahedral meshes directly from voxels using variational clustering, avoiding intermediate surfaces and preserving boundary accuracy.
